clarifications: Didymograptus scoped to D.murchisoni type-centered pendent near-parallel fork, not arbitrary outward Y.
Monograptus scoped to M.priodon with hooked overlapping tubes; genus-level growth extrapolation beyond relief fragment explicit.

Diplograptus scoped to D.pristis Hisinger1837, not Hall1865. Biform profile is conservative; compressed strongly bent proximal appearance is not asserted living truth. First-pair spines retained, no antivirgellar spines or balloon float.

Dictyonema scoped to D.retiforme Silurian type material, revised Acanthograptidae. Compound ropy stipes and actual tubular thecal bridges, not Rhabdinopora dissepiments. Whole-tubarium cone reconstruction excludes invented holdfast. Its missing proximal center is honestly open/unfinished reconstruction boundary, not a claim of a naturally ring-shaped attachment.

All four represent reconstructed skeletal tubaria of living colonies, not invented zooid soft anatomy or exact fossil casts. Palette, exact repeat counts, thickness and completed distal ends are artistic selections. Source measurements inform proportion but fossil flattening bounds are not hard living3D dimensions.
